svg.text: Three marks in the site's own language: flat faceted gold, void tile, gold hairline, Cinzel small caps.
The planner's class slot becomes the logo: a
gold-framed tile on the element ring, a Dofus
A faceted gold Dofus resting on a steel anvil — the
build, forged. Gold and steel, straight from the UI.
One gold Dofus with the anvil and a ◆ spark cut out
of it: the forge lives inside the egg.
